user.title: Sign in to AcegasApsAmga
user.description: Use the email and password of the AcegasApsAmga Servizi Online.

contratti.title: Choose the contracts
contratti.description: Choose the contracts to follow. Each contract becomes a device with its own series in the Energy dashboard.

configura_energy_dashboard.name: Configure Energy dashboard
configura_energy_dashboard.description: Adds the water consumption of every configured contract to the Energy dashboard. Existing sources are left as they are, so it is safe to run again after adding a contract.
